name: Elise
source:
Queen of succubi.
She look down on other races. She is charming to both men and women, and can bring people down to their knees. She has a calm composure.
She can absorb energy just by touching other people.
She's still a virgin because she hasn't met anyone with enough energy for the need to have sex.
